dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What did you think of this year's fireworks display?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I just hope this festival can be everything that people want it to be.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Really? I hope you're not just saying that to reassure me. I want you to be straight with me if you have any suggestions.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Anyway... If you have any time during the festival, take a look around the city. There's a lot to see, but it won't last. So make the most of it.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If only I had a little more free time... I'd love to take you around and show you everything we did to make the city look special during the festival.
